faq.title: Before you say hello.
items: I already use AI. What does Bot add?

If you keep several AI conversations open and bounce between progress updates and questions, Bot can take that work off your hands. It remembers your instructions, uses them to answer questions along the way, and handles approvals you’ve already authorized. Want to step in? Open a task card to return to the original conversation.
Where do my chats and files go?

Your chat history and notes stay on your computer. When an online model works on a task, the relevant conversation and file contents are sent to the model service you choose. Messages sent through WeChat or Telegram also pass through that platform. You choose which models and connections to use in Settings.
Will it stop if I close the window?

No. Close the chat, tuck away a task card, or hide the character—the work keeps going. You can get on with your day and check back for the result. Keep your computer awake and Bot running; it can’t keep watch while your computer is asleep or Bot is closed.
Can I change the character—or move it out of the way?

Of course. Drag it somewhere else, make it smaller, or hide it for a while. Your tasks keep running. To try another look, choose a character or outfit in Settings → Appearance, or import your own character.

faq.title: 打个招呼之前。
items: 我已经在用 AI 了，Bot 还能帮我什么？
如果你经常开着几个 AI 对话，来回看进度、回答问题，Bot 就能替你接手这些琐事。你交代过的要求，它会记着；任务中途遇到问题，它按这些要求答复，已授权的操作也能代你确认。想自己看看，点开任务卡片就能回到原来的对话。
我的聊天和文件会被传到哪里？
聊天记录和笔记保存在你的电脑上。用在线模型处理任务时，相关对话和用到的文件内容会发给你选择的模型服务；用微信、Telegram 联系 Bot 时，消息也会经过对应的平台。你可以在设置里选择用哪些模型和连接。
我把窗口关了，它会不会停下来？
不会。关掉聊天窗口、收起任务卡片，或者把角色藏起来，任务都会继续。你可以去忙别的，回来再看结果。记得让电脑保持唤醒、Bot 保持运行；电脑睡着或退出 Bot 后，它就没法继续帮你盯着了。
小伙伴能换个样子吗？挡住我工作了怎么办？
当然。拖一拖就能挪位置，也可以缩小或暂时隐藏，任务照常进行。想换个样子，去“设置 → 外观”选角色和服装，也能导入你自己的角色。
